plan.title: Submit RFQ Bid and Verify Buyer Response

steps.note: Open the prepared live RFQ on the buyer’s Responses tab; prepared-state rules require this as the first step.
Enable eRFX projects as required by the case.
Move to the separate Vendor A supplier-portal session while keeping the buyer session available.
Open the prepared live RFQ’s pricing round in the vendor portal.
Tick a required terms-and-conditions control before submitting the quote.
Enter 100 in the vendor price cells and submit the complete quote.
Verify the vendor portal reports the bid as submitted.
Verify the vendor view identifies the submitted quote as the current bid.
Verify the vendor view shows the expected total amount for the bid.
Verify the vendor view includes the GST total context.
Verify the submitted-bid view exposes the revision/edit action.
Return to the buyer’s Responses screen.
Verify the buyer sees one direct vendor response.
Open the buyer’s Master QCS comparison grid.
Verify Master QCS contains one real vendor column for the submitted bid.
Verify the buyer-side unit bid rate is 100.
Verify the buyer-side line amount and total calculations are correct.
